description: This Java class defines a custom exception 'PasswordTooWeakException' used within the account.exception package, extending RuntimeException. It is thrown when a password does not meet strength criteria.

classes.name: PasswordTooWeakException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception indicating a password is too weak. It accepts a message string for detailed error information.
